title: Cancellation and Refund — Northgate Memberships Agreement
content:
## Article 1 — Right to cancel

The primary member may cancel a membership of Northgate Memberships at any time while it is active. Member services records a cancellation-with-refund request dated the day the member asks, and the membership is cancelled only when the primary member confirms it.

## Article 2 — Status for a cancellation refund

A cancellation refund is issued only while the membership's status is active or cancelled; an expired membership has no unused year to refund, and a suspended membership's fees are settled by the membership office.

| Status on the membership record | Cancellation refund |
|---|---|
| active | may be issued |
| cancelled | may be issued |
| expired | none — no unused year to refund |
| suspended | settled by the membership office |
| closed | not issued |

The closed row follows from the article: a cancellation refund is issued only on the two statuses named.

## Article 3 — Counting days in the membership year

Days are counted as calendar days from the first day of the current membership year, that day being day 0.

*Hypothetical illustration:* for a membership year beginning 1 March, 1 March is day 0, 2 March is day 1, and 31 March is day 30.

## Article 4 — Current-year fees

The current-year fees are the new membership, renewal and upgrade difference fees charged for the current membership year less refunds already posted against those charges, plus — where the tier's refund also covers add-on card fees — the add-on card fees charged for the current membership year less refunds already posted against them.

## Article 5 — Cards and earlier years

Cancellation deactivates every card on the membership. Fees of earlier membership years are never refunded.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

The following clauses of this agreement are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis:

- "The current-year fees are refunded in full only when the cancellation is requested no later than the tier's full-refund window of calendar days after the first day of the current membership year." — no longer in force.
- "After that window the tier refunds the unused whole months, in twelfths, of the current-year fees where the tier refunds after the window, and nothing where it does not." — no longer in force.
- "Where the tier's refund is reduced by Annual Reward, the refund is reduced by the Annual Reward of the current year and never goes below zero; the Annual Reward balance is then forfeited and no certificate is issued for the year." — no longer in force.
- "Each refunded fee charge gets its own refund entry (full or prorated cancellation) against that charge, returned to its tender, or to a Northgate Shop Card when the charge was paid with a reward certificate." — no longer in force.

superseded_clauses: The current-year fees are refunded in full only when the cancellation is requested no later than full_refund_window_days calendar days after the first day of the current membership year.
After that window the tier refunds membership_msr_unused_whole_months twelfths of the current-year fees where prorated_refund_after_window is true, and nothing where it is false.

Each refunded fee charge gets its own refund entry (cancellation_full or cancellation_prorated) against that charge, returned to its tender, or to a Northgate Shop Card when the charge was paid with a reward certificate.

Where refund_deducts_annual_reward is true, the refund is reduced by membership_msr_year_reward_net and never goes below zero; the Annual Reward balance is then forfeited and no certificate is issued for the year.
